    • Special event services towards Sutherland will use bus stop Bankstown Central, the Mall, Stand C (2200384).

urlText: Metro services will not run between Macquarie Park and Victoria Cross
content:
Monday 11 to Thursday 14 November  
  • Nightly from 9.50pm, metro services will not run between Macquarie Park and Victoria Cross.
  • Metro services run between Tallawong and Macquarie Park, and between Victoria Cross and Sydenham only, to a changed frequency.
  • Buses run between Macquarie University and Victoria Cross:
    • Change at Macquarie University for buses to North Ryde, Chatswood, Crows Nest or Victoria Cross
    • Remain on the metro for Macquarie Park
  • The last direct metro from Tallawong to Sydenham leaves Tallawong at 21:10, and the last metro from Sydenham to Tallawong leaves Sydenham at 21:24.

  • Buses also replace T1 North Shore Line trains between Hornsby and Wynyard.
  • If travelling between the City and Metro North West stations catch a train to Epping via Strathfield, then change for metro services towards Tallawong or Macquarie Park.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
9M Macquarie University, then all stations to Victoria Cross and return
21T1 Chatswood, then all stations to Wynyard and return
